title: Natural Gradient Learning in Predictive Coding through Lateral Circuits
abstract: arXiv:2611.16666v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Predictive coding (PC) trains neural networks through local energy-minimization dynamics without depending on a global error signal that backpropagation (BP) requires. Although PC is a promising alternative algorithm for efficient learning, the computational cost of inference dynamics currently outweighs the resulting learning benefits in practice. In this work, we take inspiration from optimization theory to extract more learning benefit from each inference phase. We introduce Natural PC, which augments standard PC with a lateral circuit, enabling exact and efficient natural gradient learning locally in space and time. Our lateral circuit learns the activity correlations that determine the Fisher information matrix and implicitly computes its inverse, avoiding expensive matrix inversion. Across all tested image reconstruction benchmarks, Natural PC achieves state of the art in terms of sample and compute efficiency compared to existing

translated_title: 通过侧向回路实现预测编码中的自然梯度学习
translated_abstract: 预测编码通过局部能量最小化动力学来训练神经网络，无需依赖反向传播所必需的全局误差信号。尽管预测编码是一种有前景的高效学习替代算法，但在实践中，推理动力学的计算成本目前超过了其带来的学习收益。在这项工作中，我们从优化理论中汲取灵感，以便从每个推理阶段中获取更多的学习收益。我们提出了Natural PC，它通过一个侧向回路来增强标准的预测编码，从而在空间和时间上实现精确且高效的局部自然梯度学习。我们的侧向回路学习决定Fisher信息矩阵的活动相关性，并隐式地计算其逆矩阵，从而避免了昂贵的矩阵求逆操作。在所有测试的图像重建基准任务中，与现有方法相比，Natural PC在样本效率和计算效率方面均达到了最先进的水平。
tldr: 该论文提出Natural PC，通过引入侧向回路学习决定Fisher信息矩阵的活动相关性并隐式计算其逆，使预测编码在空间和时间局部范围内实现精确高效的自然梯度学习，在图像重建基准中达到样本与计算效率的最先进水平。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Natural PC, which augments predictive coding with a lateral circuit that learns the activity correlations determining the Fisher information matrix and implicitly computes its inverse, enabling exact and efficient natural gradient learning locally in space and time, and achieving state-of-the-art sample and compute efficiency on image reconstruction benchmarks.
